brand.tagline: Route it · Track it · Prove it
home.sub: Describe a civic problem in any language — type it, say it, or photograph it. Our AI finds the right department, gives you one ID, and closes it only when the fix is verified.
home.howSub: One complaint, four steps, no running between offices.
home.step1d: Speak, type or photograph the problem in your own language.
home.step2d: AI reads it, picks the category and department, sets priority and a deadline.
home.step3d: One ID, one live timeline. Get notified at every step.
home.step4d: Closes only with an after-photo and your confirmation.
home.deptSub: Stop hunting for the right website. AI walks your complaint to the correct desk.
home.mapSub: Open issues grouped by location. The number on a pin is how many citizens reported the same problem.
home.ctaTitle: Your street. Your voice. One ID.
home.ctaSub: It takes about a minute. No forms to hunt for, no department to guess.
lodge.title: Lodge a complaint
lodge.sub: Three short steps. The AI card on the right fills in as you type.
lodge.describeHint: Write naturally — English, हिंदी, मराठी or a mix. The officer will see a translation.
lodge.placeholder: e.g. There is a big pothole near the school gate and two-wheelers keep skidding…
lodge.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser. Please type instead.
lodge.photosHint: Up to 3 photos. They are compressed on your phone before upload.
lodge.locationHint: Use your GPS or drag the pin to the exact spot.
lodge.gpsDenied: We could not get your location. Drag the pin on the map instead.
lodge.aiIdle: Start typing to see how we will route this.
lodge.aiLowConfidence: We are not fully sure — a person will double-check the routing.
lodge.aiCorrection: Not right? Pick the correct category:
lodge.dupBody: {code} looks like the same problem about {distance} m away. Add your voice to it instead?
lodge.dupJoined: Added. Your report is now part of the existing issue.
lodge.successBody: Save this ID — you can track it any time, no login needed.
track.title: Track a complaint
track.sub: Anyone can check status with just the ID — no login needed.
track.notFound: We could not find a complaint with that ID.
track.thanks: Thank you — your feedback is recorded.
track.awaitingPhoto: After-photo will appear here once the work is done.
track.messagePlaceholder: Write a message to the department…
track.autoConfirm: Auto-confirms in {days} days if you do not respond.
chat.title: Shikayat Saathi
chat.sub: Tell me the problem in your words. I will file it for you.
chat.start: Namaste! What is the problem? Describe it in English, हिंदी or मराठी.
chat.askLocation: Got it — {category} for {department}. Where is it? Share your location or type the area.
chat.askPhoto: Anything to show? Add a photo, or skip.
chat.confirm: I will file: {category} → {department}, priority {priority}. Shall I submit?
chat.done: Filed! Your complaint ID is {code}. I will keep you updated here.
map.title: Open issues near you
map.sub: Only the issue is public — never personal details.
my.title: My complaints
my.sub: Everything you have lodged, in one place.
my.empty: You have not lodged any complaints yet.
login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Citizens use email or phone. Officers and admins use their work account.
login.name: Full name
login.demoHint: One click to explore each role.
officer.title: Priority queue
officer.sub: Sorted by priority score, not by date. The most dangerous, most overdue problem is always first.
officer.search: Search by ID, area or text
officer.empty: All clear — no complaints in this view.
officer.transferReason: Why is this the wrong department?
officer.resolveSub: Closing needs an after-photo and a real note saying what was done.
officer.noteHint: e.g. Garbage lifted by truck, area swept and sanitised.
officer.afterPhotoHint: Required. Take it at the spot.
officer.honest: Not your department? Transfer instead of fake-closing.
admin.title: City overview
admin.sub: Everything the administration needs to see, on one screen.
admin.reviewQueue: Complaints the AI was unsure about
admin.heatmapSub: Open complaints per ward, coloured by average priority.
help.title: Help
help.sub: Answers to the things citizens ask most.
departments.title: Departments
departments.sub: Who handles what, and how long they have.
